openstreetmap.plugin.title: OpenStreetMap
openstreetmap.plugin.summary: The free, open map: no key; used abroad and wherever no other provider's key is set. Tiles go through this computer and are cached; place search (Nominatim) and routes (OSRM, no transit or live traffic) use its free services. Turned off, the map page and lookups use the other providers only
openstreetmap.plugin.keep.chat: Places mentioned in chats (that's chat history)
openstreetmap.plugin.purge.tiles: Map tiles cached on this computer
